motive.description: Agent view of the charter: objective, decisions, open questions
motive.instruction: One per unit of work; record decisions via $GW event append; holds AC and agent detail
motive.template:
---
created: {{created}}
status: {{status}}
---

# {{title}}

Agent view. The human view of this change is the PR body draft at .groundwork/work/{slug}/pr-body.md.

## Objective

State the intent this motive exists to achieve, in one or two sentences.

## Decisions

List each settled decision with its reason.

## Open questions

List unresolved questions that still need an answer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State one testable criterion. Evidence: name the test, command, or artifact that proves it.

spec.description: Agent view of the spec: requirements and AC, folded into durable docs
spec.instruction: Set folds_into to the durable doc, or none with a reason; holds AC
spec.template:
---
folds_into: {{folds_into}}
reason: {{reason}}
change_kinds: []
repro_test: ""
---

# {{title}}

Agent view. The human view of this change is the PR body draft at .groundwork/work/{slug}/pr-body.md.

change_kinds lists every kind that applies: bugfix, refactor, cli-flag, config-key, data-format, migration, dependency. The H2 gate auto-passes only bugfix (with repro_test naming the failing test) and refactor. Any other kind, an unknown kind, an empty list, or a TBD acceptance criterion holds the run for a human.

## Purpose

State what this spec covers and why it exists.

## Requirements

List each requirement as a testable statement.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State one observable condition. Name the evidence that proves it (test name, command output, or artifact).

## Execution notes

Optional. Record files, commands, and ledger ids that the work needs.

ticket.description: Agent view of one actionable task, holds acceptance criteria
ticket.instruction: Number tickets with a two-digit prefix; holds AC
ticket.template:
---
title: {{title}}
---

# {{title}}

Agent view. The human view of this change is the PR body draft at .groundwork/work/{slug}/pr-body.md.

## Goal

State the outcome this ticket delivers in one or two sentences.

## Acceptance criteria

List the observable conditions that must hold for the ticket to count as done.

## Execution notes

Optional. Record files, commands, and ledger ids that the work needs.

map.description: Overview map of the work and its parts
map.instruction: Keep to a short overview; link tickets and docs

research.description: Investigation of one question with graded confidence
research.instruction: State the question and confidence in frontmatter

plan.description: Ordered steps to deliver the work
plan.instruction: List steps; update as the work changes

design.description: Agent view of the design: context and chosen approach
design.instruction: Explain context first, then the design; holds agent detail and AC
design.template:
---
title: {{title}}
---

# {{title}}

Agent view. The human view of this change is the PR body draft at .groundwork/work/{slug}/pr-body.md.

## Context

State the problem, constraints, and background that shape this design.

## Design

Describe the chosen approach, its main parts, and how they fit together.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State one testable criterion. Evidence: name the test, command, or artifact that proves it.

handoff.description: State for the next session: done and next
handoff.instruction: Write when pausing so a successor can resume
handoff.template:
---
title: {{title}}
---

# {{title}}

## Done

List what is finished and where the result lives.

## Next

List the remaining steps in order, with any blockers.

evidence.description: Captured proof that a requirement is met
evidence.instruction: One file per proof; no template

out-of-scope.description: Ideas and requests deliberately not done
out-of-scope.instruction: Record rejected scope here, not in .out-of-scope/

lessons.instruction: Capture lessons here, not in a lessons/ folder

adr.description: Agent-view decision record that can span motives: context, decision, rejected alternatives
adr.instruction: Number with a four-digit prefix; link it from a DECISION event via $GW event append --type DECISION --data '{"adr":"<path>"}'; supersede an accepted record instead of editing it
adr.template:
---
status: accepted
---

# {{title}}

## Context

State the forces and constraints that made this decision necessary.

## Decision

State the decision taken, in one or two sentences.

## Rejected alternatives

List each rejected option with why it lost.

## Consequences

Record what becomes easier or harder because of this decision.

pr-body.description: Draft PR body: the human view of this change, reviewed before implementation and published as the PR description
pr-body.instruction: Only what could flip a reviewer's yes/no; What changed is approved at H1/H2, so fill Evidence and Residual risk as work lands
pr-body.template:
## What changed

State the point of the change in one or two sentences. Say what a user or reader sees now that they did not see before. Then give the reasons a reviewer needs to judge it.

## Evidence

One bullet for each acceptance criterion. Write the criterion text. Link it to its proof: a GitHub permalink pinned to a commit, a test name, or a screenshot.

- <criterion text> — <permalink, test name, or screenshot>

## Residual risk

Name what this change does not cover, and what could still go wrong. Write "None known" if nothing remains.
